## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Partial and out of date: poland-law holds the Constitution and 6 of the 7 main codes with amendment history, but the codes stop at their 2023-2024 unified texts (Kodeks karny misses at least 6 amending acts in force 2024-07-01 to 2026-08-23), the KPA is missing, and its 1,608 ustawy are about 26% of the 6,097 in force. The Supreme Court and Constitutional Tribunal repositories stop in 2016 and 2015 although marked current, and the administrative-court repository is empty.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
